## About this site

This is the Hugo half of the parity fixture site. Its Jekyll counterpart lives
in `tests/oracle/` and must render the same HTML.

{{< prompt tip >}}
**Tip**: the About tab uses `layout: page`, so `refactor-content` is **not**
applied upstream. It is the control case for headings, images and code blocks.
{{< /prompt >}}

Edit {{< filepath "_config.yml" >}} to change the timezone.
